This is a public issue. Use invented examples only. Do not upload real supplier lists, catalogs, customer data, credentials or payment information. This is not an order or reservation; no money is being requested or accepted.

## The last supplier price update
What kind of store or workflow was this, approximately how many rows, and how often do lists arrive? No business name is needed.

## The troublesome step
What did you actually have to do, and which step took time or caused mistakes?

## Your current solution
Spreadsheet formulas, an existing app, manual matching or something else? What is already good enough?

## File requirements
CSV or XLSX? Do both files have stable, matching SKUs? Describe generally; do not attach real files.

## Value of a standalone offline file
Would keeping an offline HTML utility matter to you? Why or why not?

## Proposed price: US$19 once
Would you consider paying this for the described utility as it stands? "No" is useful. If something is missing, name the one requirement that matters most. This answer is non-binding, not a purchase, and not evidence of a sale.

## Reply permission
By opening this issue, you agree to a reply here about this feedback. We will not use it as permission to contact you elsewhere.
